mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% signals economic stress, prompting market anticipation of policy support and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days; the interaction of both series is necessary for the signal.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% MoM, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a supply shock, leading to temporary economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below 100, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payrolls trend indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 3.0% (year-over-year CPI change) prompts market anticipation of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and housing starts signals a robust economic expansion, driving strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days; the joint behavior of both series is required for the signal.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 QoQ > 0.5% and HOUST MoM > 0.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During the early stages of a monetary tightening cycle (federal funds rate rising above 1.0%), higher discount rates lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
